via_only_plan.manufacturing_basis: All implicated vias are 0.20 mm drill / 0.40 mm copper. The proposed 0.35 mm copper diameter preserves a 0.15 mm diameter difference (0.075 mm radial annulus).
via_only_plan.warning: VIA-only shrink is monotonic-safe for different-net spacing but does not clear all VIA rows. Apply only as a reviewed pilot and rerun native DRC.

via_candidate_gate.monotonic_safety: Reducing only VIA copper diameter cannot create a new different-net spacing violation; drill positions and diameters remain unchanged.
remaining_validation: confirm manufacturer acceptance of each hole/diameter pair
re-export and compare all 793 drill positions and diameters

track_reroute_plan.policy: Do not reduce track width below the selected rule minimum. Translate or locally dogleg the chosen segment, retain the original net/layer and both endpoint contacts, then rerun full DRC because FILL and adjacent-route constraints are coupled.

outline_plan.recommendation: Preserve the 1.3 mm NPTH and expand the internal square Board Outline symmetrically; do not reduce the authoritative drill. This changes the mechanical cutout from 1.8 mm to 1.92 mm, leaves about 0.31 mm to the 1.3 mm drill, and requires enclosure/fabricator review.

limitations: This is a static plan, not a native DRC result after repair.
The VIA calculation is exact only for radial copper-diameter reduction at fixed centers.
Track translations are suggestions only; no route candidate is emitted until whole-board geometry and endpoint connectivity are rechecked.
The internal CN1 cutout change is mechanical and cannot be approved from electrical DRC alone.
FILL-related violations are intentionally left to the separate fill-clearance plan.
